what_was_added.nan_handling: NaN where bread_quantity_h{h} is NaN; anchor=0 rows also get NaN

do_not_repeat.evidence: iter006: residual approach gave val_mae=49.20 for h=1 (worse than raw target 39.36). Train/val mean residual asymmetry persisted.
do_not_repeat.why_not_again: Additive residual does not remove level shift. Multiplicative ratio does.

next_iteration_contract.why_this_node: Train per-horizon models on ratio_h{h} target using non-COVID training rows. Select algorithm per horizon.
next_iteration_contract.read_this_first: For each horizon h: train on train_mask & ~is_covid_lockdown_period rows, predicting ratio_h{h}. Convert predictions to units: pred_units = pred_ratio x anchor. Compare pred_units val MAE to baseline floor. Algorithm selection per horizon: h=1,7 -> LightGBM (regression_l1 or huber); h=14,30 -> LightGBM with heavier regularization OR Ridge; h=60 -> Ridge/ElasticNet (only 35 val rows); h=90 -> Ridge or anchor multiplier only (5 val rows, tree models not learnable). Feature set: use all features from iter009 FE CSV except other ratio_h{h2} columns and bread_quantity_h{h2} columns for h2 != h.

per_horizon_algorithm_guidance.h1: LightGBM regression_l1 or huber, Optuna or manual tuning
per_horizon_algorithm_guidance.h14: LightGBM with higher min_child_samples/L2, or Ridge
per_horizon_algorithm_guidance.h30: LightGBM with heavier regularization, or Ridge/ElasticNet
per_horizon_algorithm_guidance.h60: Ridge or ElasticNet with CV alpha (35 val rows, prefer linear)
per_horizon_algorithm_guidance.h90: Ridge with 2-3 features only, or constant anchor (5 val rows)

handoff.read_this_first: Ratio target columns added: ratio_h{h} = bread_quantity_h{h} / anchor_h{h} clipped to [0.05, 5.0]. Training filters COVID rows (is_covid_lockdown_period==1). Use per-horizon algorithm selection (LightGBM for h<=14, Ridge/ElasticNet for h>=60). Convert ratio predictions back to units for floor comparison.

durable_rules.rule: Use multiplicative ratio (y/anchor), NOT additive residual (y-anchor).
durable_rules.why: Additive residual failed in iter006. Ratio removes level shift multiplicatively.

durable_rules.rule: Convert ratio predictions back to bread_quantity units before floor comparison: pred_units = pred_ratio x anchor.
durable_rules.why: Baseline floor is in units (MAE of bread_quantity). Ratio MAE is not comparable.

durable_rules.rule: Select algorithm per horizon; do not use LightGBM for h=60 and h=90.
durable_rules.why: h=60 has only 35 scoreable val rows; h=90 has only 5. Tree models cannot generalize on such small samples.
